title: Top-Up Purchases on Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Billing Note — Topping Up a Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs Pack

**Clause.** A paid program of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs that is active or exhausted may be topped up with at least the pack's smallest top-up, in units, at the pack's price per top-up unit. The top-up is invoiced separately and booked on the top-up date. Where the pack's top-up resets the expiry date, the expiry date becomes the top-up date plus the pack's unit validity in months; elsewhere the original expiry date stands. A top-up on an exhausted program makes it active again the same day. An expired or cancelled program is never topped up; the client buys a new pack instead.

## The top-up invoice

The top-up invoice is the number of units topped up multiplied by the pack's price per top-up unit, rounded to the cent. It is a separate invoice from the pack invoice.

*Hypothetical illustration:* 120 units topped up at a hypothetical 7.25 USD per top-up unit are invoiced 870.00 USD (120 multiplied by 7.25), booked on the top-up date.

## Program status and the top-up

| Program status | Top-up? | Status after the top-up |
|---|---|---|
| active (paid) | Yes, at least the smallest top-up | active |
| exhausted (paid) | Yes, at least the smallest top-up | active again the same day |
| expired | Never — the client buys a new pack instead | — |
| cancelled | Never — the client buys a new pack instead | — |

## Expiry date after a top-up

| The pack's top-up resets the expiry date? | Expiry date after the top-up |
|---|---|
| Yes | the top-up date plus the pack's unit validity in months |
| No | the original expiry date, unchanged |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a top-up on 2026-04-10 on a pack with a hypothetical 12-month validity whose top-up resets the expiry date moves the expiry date to 2027-04-10. On a pack whose top-up does not reset it, the original expiry date stands whatever the top-up date.

## Points of judgement

**Is there a smallest top-up?** Yes. A top-up is at least the pack's smallest top-up in units.

**Does the top-up share the pack's invoice?** No. It is invoiced separately.

**Can an expired program be revived with a top-up?** No. An expired or cancelled program is never topped up; the client buys a new pack instead.
